modules.module_title: Determine the functional, non-functional, and infrastructural — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams (designers, engineers, manufacturing, marketing) to elicit and document comprehensive requirements. This includes understanding user needs, business goals, and technical constraints. Methods employed should include interviews, workshops, surveys, and document analysis.

Create a detailed requirements specification document covering both functional and non- functional requirements, this should include use cases,user stories,functional requirements and non- functional requirements

Create detailed description of the application's features and capabilities (e.g., slicing algorithms, printer control, material management, error handling, post-processing support, data visualization, reporting, information sharing, etc.).

Create specifications related to performance (speed, scalability, throughput), security (authentication, authorization, data protection), reliability, usability, maintainability, and compliance (regulatory standards).
Define the types and structures of data to be processed and stored by the application. This includes designing the database schema and considering data integrity, consistency, and security.

Identify and document all physical and virtual resources required for development, deployment, and operation of the 3D printing application. This includes hardware (servers, printers, network equipment), software (operating systems, databases, middleware), and personnel

Define the application infrastructure (architecture, deployment environment, network topology) necessary to support the 3D printing process. Address considerations such as high availability, scalability, and security

Determine how the application will integrate with existing systems (e.g., CAD software, ERP systems, cloud storage, other software applications). Detail the methods of integration (APIs, data exchange protocols, etc.) and address any interoperability challenges

Describe how the application will leverage other technologies such as AI/ML (for optimization and predictive maintenance), cloud computing (for scalability and cost-efficiency), IoT (for real-time monitoring and control), and other relevant technologies.
Identify and document the tools and processes needed for efficient infrastructure management (configuration management, monitoring, logging, security management, automated deployment).
Define security requirements and strategies to protect sensitive data and ensure compliance with relevant regulations (e.g., GDPR, HIPAA).
Define the scalability and capacity requirements of the application to ensure it can handle projected growth in data volume, user base, and processing demands. Document capacity planning methods used
Define appropriate SLAs for the 3D printing application, specifying performance targets, availability, and support

modules.module_title: Translate the 3dp processes into relevant application — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Create comprehensive storyboards depicting the user flow and key interactions within the 3D printing application. These storyboards should illustrate different user scenarios and processes at a high level. The storyboard should reflect the overall user experience

Develop multiple versions of technical wireframes, focusing on key functionalities like slicing modules, printer management, material management,post processing support,data visualization and information sharing

Create detailed data flow diagrams illustrating the flow of information across the 3D printing system. This should encompass data from input (3D models, parameters), through processing (slicing, printer control), to output (printed object, status reports).
Design the overall software architecture for a cloud-based 3D printing application that integrates multiple systems
Detail the integration with cloud storage services (AWS S3, Azure Blob Storage, etc.) for storing and managing 3D models, print settings, and print results.

Compare a microservices-based architecture to a monolithic architecture, justifying the choice of architecture in the context of 3D printing, focusing on scalability, maintainability, and resilience. Identify specific services that would be suitable for decoupling (e.g., slicing, printer control, post- processing).
Document how the application integrates with external systems (e.g., CAD software, CAM software, material databases).

Develop a user-friendly graphical user interface (GUI) for interacting with the 3D printer’s firmware. The GUI should allow users to control printer settings, monitor the print process, and handle potential errors. Wireframes and mockups should be created and thoroughly tested (usability testing is highly recommended).

modules.module_title: Build high-performance software applications by developing — Core Assessment Criteria

pcs.pc_description: Develop algorithms for optimizing printing parameters (e.g., layer height, extrusion speed, temperature) to improve print quality, speed, and material usage.

Create algorithms for simulating the 3D printing process to predict outcomes and identify potential problems before printing. This could include simulations of material flow, heat transfer, or structural integrity
Design and develop firmware to be installed on 3D printers. The firmware should efficiently control various aspects of the printer operation (Motion control, G-Code interpretation,Error handling)
Design, develop, and maintain efficient, reusable, and reliable code modules. Adhere to coding best practices (e.g., modular design, proper commenting, code reviews).
Develop pipelines to extract and process data from multiple sources like databases, knowledge bases
Leverage API connections and scripts to seamlessly integrate with existing software applications and packages (e.g., CAD software, cloud storage services).
Develop and deploy software applications to both on-premise and cloud environments. Address different deployment strategies and technologies (e.g., containerization, serverless functions).
Identify methods to enhance file import capabilities, supporting a broader range of file formats (STL, OBJ, etc.) and handling large files efficiently.
Implement security measures to protect application data and prevent unauthorized access. This might include data encryption, network security, authentication and Authorization
Identify potential risks and threats (e.g., cybersecurity vulnerabilities, buffer overflow, data corruption). Develop comprehensive mitigation plans to address these risks.

Optimize the software application for performance, scalability, and resource utilization. Incorporate techniques such as code optimization, database tuning, and caching. Address industry requirements for speed and efficiency
Implement a comprehensive testing strategy that includes unit testing, integration testing,automated testing
